valuation_template_rationale: No specialized template covers a listed Bitcoin treasury with a secondary software business. Sum of parts explicitly values disclosed Bitcoin and software, adds the current USD reserve, deducts debt and preferred liquidation claims, and uses post-period disclosed common issuance in the denominator.
bear_assumptions: Value 842,138 disclosed bitcoin at USD 45,000, software at USD 0.5 billion, and the USD reserve at USD 4.0 billion; deduct USD 6.710 billion debt and USD 15.356 billion preferred claims after disclosed repurchases, then divide by 387.237 million disclosed common shares including the latest ATM issuance.
base_assumptions: Value 842,138 disclosed bitcoin at USD 70,000, software at USD 1.0 billion, and the USD reserve at USD 4.0 billion; deduct USD 6.710 billion debt and USD 15.356 billion preferred claims after disclosed repurchases, then divide by 387.237 million disclosed common shares including the latest ATM issuance.
bull_assumptions: Value 842,138 disclosed bitcoin at USD 100,000, software at USD 2.0 billion, and the USD reserve at USD 4.0 billion; deduct USD 6.710 billion debt and USD 15.356 billion preferred claims after disclosed repurchases, then divide by 387.237 million disclosed common shares including the latest ATM issuance.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or higher primary-evidence NAV makes expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence, and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade if bitcoin per fully diluted share declines, the USD reserve cannot fund claims without adverse issuance or sales, senior claims rise faster than assets, or capital access closes during a Bitcoin drawdown.
